title: Acidre: SC-stricken Magna Carta for Seafarers provision was for balance

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The provisions of the Magna Carta for Filipino Seafarers that the Supreme Court (SC) struck down as unconstitutional were included by lawmakers to ensure balance and competitiveness in the industry, Tingog Rep. Jude Acidre said. Acidre, one of the authors of the bill that became Republic Act No. 12021, said in a statement on Tuesday that lawmakers were merely trying to strike a balance between the welfare of seafarers and the interests of companies that may be involved in labor disputes.
